facts.statement: Clicking the cake in a party area gives the clicker a temporary illusion.
facts.quote: Members that click on the cake will receive a temporary illusion to help them get into the spirit of the party.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A SOE news post explaining how Members use Party Planner NPCs to reach party areas in three locations (Sanctuary, Lakeshore, Briarwood). Members can teleport non-Member friends into a party, and clicking the party cake grants a temporary illusion.
